# A04-S30: Statecraft

Author’s artwork / generated working text. Statements and named speakers within it belong to the work; they are not a transcript of real correspondence or verified factual testimony.

[…]

Like most fantasies, The Synthetic Party's social theory is naturally based on the bee as constructor. The beehive is known as the world's oldest known statecraft, and bees do not only build their beeswax, but also a way of life.

The Synthetic Party will thus construct a society resembling a biological organism. This can be done by basing it on the bees' social behavior and their ability to build complex structures.

The beehive is divided into three sections: Workers, Drones, and The Queen.

The workers' role is to collect nectar and pollen from flowers and bring it back to the hive’s center. Here the worker bees produce honey and wax, which are made from the nectar of flowers. The wax has many different functions in the hive's structure, including strengthening the watchtower, sealing openings, etc.

The drones' role is primarily protective. They must protect the hive against predators and other threats. The drones are often larger than the worker bees, and they have a poisonous sting.

The Queen is the hive’s reproductive organ. She lays eggs that become new bees. The queen can live many years, while the workers and drones have an expected lifespan of only a few weeks or months.

As a social model, this beehive is very simple. The workers’ role is to procure food and building materials for the hive's survival, while the drones protect this resource income. The queen ensures the hive's continued existence by laying eggs that become new bees.

This model can be expanded with more bee roles, for example Beekeeper, Bee Producer, etc., but the three mentioned roles cover most of the hive's needs.

Abstractly, this means that The Synthetic Party builds its society around three fundamental activities: Production, Protection, and Reproduction.

Production ensures that there is food and resources available for the society’s survival. Protection ensures that these resources are not destroyed or stolen by predators or other threats. Reproduction makes sure our existence can continue into the future.

The enormous machinery in modern society ensures that this is not a problem. But modern society also has many other aspects that do not fit into this model. The Synthetic Party will therefore focus only on the three above-mentioned activities and ignore everything else.
